displayedInputs.question:
A circle of radius \(1\) is surrounded by \(4\) circles of radius \(r\) as shown. What is \(r?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

The wheel shown is spun twice, and the randomly determined numbers opposite the pointer are recorded. The first number is divided by \(4,\) and the second number is divided by \(5.\) The first remainder designates a column, and the second remainder designates a row on the checkerboard shown. What is the probability that the pair of numbers designates a shaded square?

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

Right \(\triangle ABC\) has \(AB=3,\) \(BC=4,\) and \(AC=5.\) Square \(XYZW\) is inscribed in \(\triangle ABC\) with \(X\) and \(Y\) on \(\overline{AC},\) \(W\) on \(\overline{AB},\) and \(Z\) on \(\overline{BC}.\) What is the side length of the square?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

The point \(O\) is the center of the circle circumscribed about \(\triangle ABC,\) with \(\angle BOC=120^\circ\) and \(\angle AOB=140^\circ,\) as shown. What is the degree measure of \(\angle ABC?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

\(650\) students were surveyed about their pasta preferences. The choices were lasagna, manicotti, ravioli and spaghetti. The results of the survey are displayed in the bar graph. What is the ratio of the number of students who preferred spaghetti to the number of students who preferred manicotti?

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

In trapezoid \(ABCD,\) \(\overline{AD}\) is perpendicular to \(\overline{DC},\) \(AD = AB = 3,\) and \(DC = 6.\) In addition, \(E\) is on \(\overline{DC},\) and \(\overline{BE}\) is parallel to \(\overline{AD}.\) Find the area of \(\triangle BEC.\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

To complete the grid below, each of the digits \(1\) through \(4\) must occur once in each row and once in each column. What number will occupy the lower right-hand square?

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

Tiles \(I,\) \(II,\) \(III\) and \(IV\) are translated so one tile coincides with each of the rectangles \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C\) and \(D.\) In the final arrangement, the two numbers on any side common to two adjacent tiles must be the same. Which of the tiles is translated to Rectangle \(C?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
